sloka: अन्तःपुरगतो वाली श्रुत्वा शब्दममर्षणः ।निष्पपात सह स्त्रीभिस्ताराभिरिव चन्द्रमाः ॥४-११-२८॥।।
transliteration: antaḥpuragato vālī śrutvā śabdamamarṣaṇaḥ ।niṣpapāta saha strībhistārābhiriva candramāḥ ॥4-11-28॥।।

translations.english: 'Unable to tolerate the sound, Vali jumped out of the harem along with the women like the Moon with stars.
